title: The Gift of the Magi

license.content: 原创复述：旁白为自写英文复述（原著 O. Henry《The Gift of the Magi》1905，公有领域，短引原句亦为公版）；底图、配乐为 AI 原创生成，音效代码合成

music.title: The Gift of the Magi
music.author: Galanty
music.attribution: The Gift of the Magi — Galanty, original score generated with Lyria 3 Pro and edited with code-synthesized sound design (CC0 1.0)
music.modifications: Generated with Google Lyria 3 Pro (lyria-3-pro-preview) from an original timeline prompt (piano, strings, music box); re-arranged into six sections by tools/production/gift-magi-20261013/music_build.py (0.8 s equal-power crossfades, a full rest before the twist, 4.5 dB pre-duck under narration, 240 Hz dip, 138 NumPy-synthesized SFX: coins, scissors, door bells, clock strike, ticks, footsteps, paper, sparkles, snow-night air; no third-party samples), then encoded to 48 kbps MP3, 48 kHz stereo (library size budget). Timed to sample S110; other films will not hit its accents.

note: 英文样片。旁白为预先生成的 Gemini 云端配音（音色 Sulafat，随包旁白种子，播放不联网）；改旁白文字后新句需要自备 Gemini key 用同一条自定义命令，或本机配音整片重配。底图（AI 生成）以 data URI 内联在幕代码里，导出成片用的是 1920 宽高清图。配乐 The Gift of the Magi（CC0，随包曲库 library:original-gift-of-the-magi）按本片逐字时间轴重排并合成音效，反转处整段静音一拍：改停顿、语速或换曲后音效与静音不再对齐。画面卡点词都在各幕 meta.params。正文约 121 秒，导出时接约 4.9 秒品牌片尾
